english.title: PSV operator fail to notify Secretary of State of alteration to public service vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a PSV operator's licence, on an alteration otherwise than by replacement of parts being made in the structure or fixed equipment of a public service vehicle owned by you, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to give notice of the alteration to the Secretary of State as soon as was practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(2) and (4) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
